documents.title: FAERS quarterly extract — orlistat / acute pancreatitis
documents.text:
openFDA — FAERS Adverse Event Reporting System — Quarterly extract, suspect drug: orlistat.
Total reports matching the query (orlistat + acute pancreatitis): 37.

Case narrative (representative, report 10023451-7):
A 46-year-old female with obesity started orlistat 120 mg three times daily with meals.
Six weeks later she presented with epigastric pain; serum lipase was elevated (3.4 x ULN) and
acute pancreatitis was diagnosed. Orlistat was discontinued and the event resolved.
Reporter causality: possible. Confounders: gallstone disease, alcohol use not documented.

Note: FAERS reports are voluntary and unverified; they do not establish causation and cannot be
used to compute incidence because total exposure is unknown.
